rationale: The directly retrieved 10.6 product-specific Restrictions section explicitly excludes Moderate, High and IL5. The same-version regional table names Moderate and excludes High and IL5, and its third-party-store section excludes all three. The 10.7 regional and expanded sections preserve the same distinctions. The April 8 change log names High and IL5 for relevant 10.3 releases. The separate Cloud Flex catalog names generic third-party object-store products and a FedRAMP/IL5 subscription, without joining those entries. The February public-sector matrix marks Moderate for S3 and leaves High and IL5 blank. The documented conflict remains unresolved.
